description: This file defines the LikeOperator class, which implements string filtering logic for a JSON API in SuiteCRM. It provides methods to generate filter tags, SQL operators, and validate operators, specifically for 'LIKE' string matching.

classes.name: LikeOperator
classes.description: A class that implements a string filter operator for 'LIKE' comparisons in SuiteCRM's JSON API filters.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter operator tag, which is 'li'.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string and checks its validity via parent class.
